assessments.source_anchor: ## What this connector can and cannot do
assessments.rationale: It can manage translation workspace data and locale rollout, but explicitly cannot read or edit the codebase needed to wire the app and deliver changed files.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Codebase access and an implementation workflow to select the runtime, wire locale loading and language selection, and deliver changed project files.
